source: scripts/claim-counts.py in openIE-dev/rce, run on public main (with RCE_SPEC_CHECK set to rce-spec-check built from the same commit); the Lean audit is scripts/lean-audit.sh at the same commit
note_on_0_9: Draft 0.9 is on public main since cdae5cf. It specifies Appendix F; the reference checker implements part of it, and a construct it does not implement requires change as reserved, not implemented (W-RES-1, F.12). Theorems T42 to T56 are stated in Appendix F.9; T48, T51 and T53 are proved of models and the other twelve are unproved. The interactive notebook on this site (spec-src/rce/spec.json) shows the document generated from public main at the commit recorded in that file, whose commit, commit date and draft spec-src/rce/gen.mjs reads from git and the spec book, with the browser checker built from the same commit; its example counts are read from the notebook data, and the other counts in this file were read at 0c015c43.
lean_audit_definition: The audit (scripts/lean-audit.sh, audit/Audit.lean) counts every theorem constant in the kernel environment, including constants the elaborator generates, so it is larger than the number of theorem and lemma declarations written in source.
theorems_stated_unproved_in_0_9: T42 to T56 except T48, T51 and T53 (proved of models); also T60, and parts of T57, T59 and T61 (spec/book/10-theorems.md)
lean_declaration_and_audit_counts_note: Rerun at public 0c015c43 on 31 October 2026 with Lean 4.12.0: lake build completes over the 62 files of spec/lean/RCE/ (85 with subdirectories), audit reports 5,055 theorem constants with standard axioms only, no sorry. Declarations are the lines starting with theorem or lemma (with optional attributes, private or protected) in all spec/lean .lean files. At e416fd0 the same counts were 1,116 declarations, 4,877 audit constants and 58 modules; at 4304048, 885 declarations, 2,949 audit constants and 46 modules.
